text:
Leo (Jul 23-Aug 23)
Daily Horoscope Prediction says, you may start the day feeling like things are in your control, or at least manageable enough not to think about them too much. There’s a sense that you know what you’re doing, where you’re headed, and how you want to show up. But as the day moves forward, that confidence doesn’t exactly disappear; it just gets interrupted in small ways. Not by anything major. More by moments where something doesn’t go exactly how you expected, or doesn’t feel as smooth as it should. And for you, that matters more than you admit.
